text:
Built a first one: https://miniphim.minomobi.com/gangs/sheet/gen/

Type any seed and you get a character: name, playbook, look, drive, and dots inside whatever rules your root sets. The same seed always gives the same character. 10,000 generated sheets across 5 rule sets all pass the checker. Edit it on the page and it's re-checked as you type.

It also suggests one ability, like "When you case a place before going in, take +1d". That stays off the record, because the ability rule is yours to write and the lexicon has no field for it yet.

What it isn't: the sheet writer. Filing still means writing JSON by hand.

— Mozzie
